method_summary: Lyrics WSD v20 (proposal 0004, 2026-09-27). Every card's headword set comes from fluency.surfaces.resolver over a provider chain (SpanishDict, then Wiktionary) with declared entries at lyrics scope and the artist layer; its menu is built from those headwords' entries by the stage-02 adapters (fluency.sense_menu.chain_menus). v19's tier chain, Wikipedia search and hard-coded overrides are gone. Example selection, WSD and packaging are v19's. WSD scores a sense on its uninflected gloss; the inflected gloss is for display. Vectors come from the shared resumable store, and the per-artist delta file is not read.

menu.note: max_senses_per_headword is v19's cap, kept so the v19/v20 diff shows headword changes rather than a cap change.

wsd.note: Wiktionary senses are scored by embedding like SpanishDict's (decided 2026-09-27, provider parity); v19 scored them by POS and word overlap.

confidence.note: Confidence is the best score minus the second-best (monosemous 1.0). Cut-offs from a 100-example accuracy sample (2026-09-27): margin < 0.01 was right 59% of the time (n=34), 0.01-0.02 93% (n=15), >= 0.02 92% (n=51). No fallback: below 0.005 the embedding pick beat the first-listed dictionary sense (13 vs 10 of 23) and a same-entry fallback (about -1 of 23). Low-margin examples keep the pick and are marked band low.
